hooks.command: if [ "$(git rev-parse --git-dir 2>/dev/null)" = "$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" ]; then if [ "$(git worktree list | wc -l)" -gt 1 ]; then echo "Note: this is the main checkout and other worktrees exist, so other sessions may be working in this repository. Offer to work in a worktree on a new branch (EnterWorktree) so edits do not mix, and check that the current branch ($(git branch --show-current)) fits this task before committing. Explain any git step in plain words."; else echo "Note: this is the only session in this checkout. Work on main. Commit and push when a full 'bash run.sh' passes; if the push is rejected because someone else pushed first, pull, run 'bash run.sh' again, then push. Explain any git step in plain words."; fi; fi; true
